        balance[a] -= c
        balance[b] += c

    positive = []
    negative = []
    
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        if balance[i] > 0:
            positive.append(balance[i])
        elif balance[i] < 0:
            negative.append(-balance[i])
    
    positive.sort(reverse=True)
    negative.sort(reverse=True)
    
    pos_idx = 0
    neg_idx = 0
    total_debt = 0
    
    while pos_idx < len(positive) and neg_idx < len(negative):
        p_val = positive[pos_idx]
        n_val = negative[neg_idx]
        
        if p_val == n_val:
            total_debt += p_val
            pos_idx += 1
            neg_idx += 1
        elif p_val > n_val:
            total_debt += n_val
            positive[pos_idx] -= n_val
            neg_idx += 1
        else:
            total_debt += p_val
            negative[neg_idx] -= p_val
            pos_idx += 1
            
    print(total_debt)
